page.layout: One printed page (left) with running text in one column, Greek and Hebrew entries, and a narrow column of marginal notes at the right edge of the scan (partly cut off, from the facing page, which is a second printed page with its own text and notes).

main_text.p: Σαρχάνη ης ἡ corbis, sporta. idem quod σαγήνη ἰδ῾ ἡ. vide infra.
Σάρδιν᾿ ὁ ὁ, ἁ σάρδιον ὁ ὁ subaudi λίθος sardius. nomen gemmæ, sic à Sardinia insula, ubi laudatissimus nascitur, dicta. Rabbini rubinum. F. J. pyropum vocat.
Σαρδόνυξ ὁ ὁ sardonyx, nomen gemmæ. compos. ex σάρδιον ὁ ὁ sardius, & ὄνυξ ὁ ὄνυξ ὁ unguis. Sic dicta fuit hæc gemma, quod colore suo unguem humanum imitetur.
Σάρξ σαρκός ἡ caro. proximus noster vocatur caro nostra Esa.58.7. plures significationes vide in Lexico N.T.
Σαρκικὸς ἡ ὀν carnalis e, Rom.7.14.
Σαρκινὸς ἡ ον carneus a um, 2.Cor.3.3. ἐν πλαξὶ σαρκίναις in tabulis carneis.
Σαρόω ῶ scopis purgo. (a Them. σαίρω verro. Fut. σαρῶ.) F. ῶσω. P. σεσαρωκα. prat.pass. σεσαρωμαι. part. prat. pass. σεσαρωμένη ἡ ον scopis purgatus.
Σαλβανὰς ᾱ ὁ. vide infra nomina propria.

Σάτον ὁ τὸ fatum, origine Hebræu [Hebrew] in statu constructo [Hebrew] unde est Syriacu [Hebrew] fata. est nomen mensuræ aridorum, & respondet sesquimodio. Estque sesquimodius, continens sex cabos, cabus vero 24. ova.

Σβέννυμι & σβέννυω extinguo. præs. imperat. σβέννυθι ὑπω. 2.pl. σβέννυτε, 1.Thess.5.19. Fut. σβέσω (tanquam à σβέω) aor.1. ἔσβεσα. aor.1. act. infin. σβέσαι. P. ἐσβέσθην. prat.pass. σβέννυμαι σβέσμαι.

page.notes: The Hebrew words (מָאנִי type forms, סָאָה) and Greek entries are printed in the scan; Hebrew and some Greek forms are partly blurred and were not read letter by letter. Right-hand facing page is cut off and largely illegible; its notes are not transcribed. Margin notes on the left page: none readable.
